| bca_protein | bca | 2 | 2 | 2 unknowns + 9 registered standards, all in duplicate |
| picogreen_dna | picogreen | 3 | 1 | 3 unknowns + 4 registered standards, single well each |

**Run conditions preserved**
- Deadline: 15:00 Shanghai = t = 25,200 s; release at t = 0 (09:00 start, no earlier release stated)
- Budget: CNY 570
- Enabled instances only: device:19 (Fluent 1080), device:18 (Fluent 780), device:67 (SpectraMax iD5), demo:ks4000:1 (KS4000 incubator), bench
